stories.title: Hackers Exploited the PHP Vulnerabilities Days Before They Were Patched
stories.take: AWS logged PHP2Shell exploit attempts four days ago and Wired says the bugs are now broadly exploited — patch first, ask questions later.

stories.title: Flaw in PHP computer language leads to shutdown of websites around world
stories.take: Governments in Belgium, the Netherlands, Finland, France and Germany took sites dark as a precaution — PHP runs almost 70% of the web.

stories.title: Meta ordered to pay $25bn to New Mexico in Cambridge Analytica data-privacy case
stories.take: A New Mexico judge orders Meta to pay $25 billion after a jury found it misled consumers over the Cambridge Analytica data grab — its biggest privacy penalty ever.

stories.title: Tesla profits drop 43% in Q3
stories.take: Tesla profit falls 43% in Q3 and its once-booming energy storage business shrinks too — the earnings story is now cost and execution, not growth.

stories.title: Tesla says it will start selling Cybercabs by end of year
stories.take: Tesla says it will sell the steering-wheel-free Cybercab by year-end, even as federal regulators still investigate whether it meets safety standards.

stories.title: Meta wants to pay for its broad AI buildout with a newly created class of stock
stories.take: Meta plans a new class of stock to fund its AI buildout — the infrastructure bill now gets its own financing instrument.

stories.title: Year-old AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at a $6B valuation
stories.take: Nine months after a $180M seed, Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at $6B to build models without ingesting half the internet.

stories.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
stories.take: Recursive releases Flint, a free laptop-sized coding model largely built by its own AI — an early public test of recursive self-improvement.

stories.title: OpenAI's latest AI models are coming to Google Cloud and Antigravity
stories.take: Google Cloud gets GPT 6.1 Astra, Sol and Luna in coming weeks — OpenAI distribution now runs through its biggest rival's cloud.

stories.title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
stories.take: Meta says Muse passes 10M users in Q3 earnings, with shopping and personal productivity as top uses.

stories.title: Joel Kaplan leaves Meta
stories.take: Joel Kaplan, long the Republican voice inside Meta and a driver of its rightward moderation shift, leaves the company.

stories.title: Mark Zuckerberg Agrees to Stay in California Despite Billionaires’ Tax Ballot Measure
stories.take: Zuckerberg agrees to stay in California despite the billionaires' tax ballot measure — the highest-profile exit threat of the cycle ends in a stay.

stories.title: RIP BioWare: EA shuts down storied RPG studio after over three decades
stories.take: EA shuts BioWare after more than three decades — the studio behind Mass Effect and Dragon Age is gone.

stories.title: Xbox wants you to pay 24 to 40 cents per hour to stream games you already bought
stories.take: Xbox wants 24 to 40 cents an hour to stream games you already bought — ownership, now with an hourly meter.

stories.title: Meta Beats Q3 Expectations With Strong Earnings
stories.take: Meta beats Q3 expectations on strong earnings — the ad business still funds the AI buildout, even on a day it took a $25B privacy hit.

stories.title: Walmart Embraces AI Agents That Shop on Behalf of Customers
stories.take: Walmart welcomes AI agents that shop for customers while Amazon blocks them — retail's agent strategy split is now explicit.

stories.title: Apple Music Rebrands With a Look Made by Sound
stories.take: Apple Music rebrands with a human-crafted look made by sound — a deliberate anti-AI-slop identity move in an AI-saturated market.

stories.title: Tilly Norwood Tells All
stories.take: AI actor Tilly Norwood tells all — the synthetic performer story moves from novelty to a real casting and rights fight.

stories.title: Netflix lowers ad revenue forecast by 10%, continues to beef up ad suite
stories.take: Netflix cuts its ad revenue forecast 10% while still building out the ad suite — growth story meets measurement reality.

stories.title: Substack Brings Dynamic Ad Insertion to Podcasts
stories.take: Substack brings dynamic ad insertion to podcasts — its creators get a real ad market without leaving the platform.

stories.title: Indie agencies want The Trade Desk and Amazon DSP to acknowledge their buying power with negotiating leverage
stories.take: Indie agencies push The Trade Desk and Amazon DSP to recognize their collective buying power — leverage, not volume, is the ask.

stories.title: Nearly 30% of holiday budgets expected to be spent by the end of October
stories.take: Nearly 30% of holiday budgets will be spent by end of October — the holiday season now starts before Halloween costumes come off.

stories.title: GTA 6 unleashes saucy ads on the streets of Miami
stories.take: GTA 6 puts saucy street ads up in Miami — Rockstar markets the game in the city that inspired it.

stories.title: Kohl’s Brings Back Ellie Kemper for Holiday Ad Campaign
stories.take: Kohl's brings back Ellie Kemper for its holiday campaign — a familiar face carries a retailer that needs a clean seasonal win.

stories.title: LeBron moonlights at center, helps limit Towns in winning debut for Sixers
stories.take: LeBron moonlights at center, helps limit Towns, and wins his Sixers debut on the Knicks' championship night — Philly spoils the banner party.

stories.title: Kawhi scores 23 points in Toronto return as Raptors rout Bulls
stories.take: Kawhi scores 23 in his Toronto return as the Raptors rout the Bulls 135-92 — a homecoming that was all business.

stories.title: Thunder have Holmgren's back -- in scuffle, and in wake of redemptive season opener
stories.take: OKC backs Holmgren in a scuffle and in a chippy opener win over the Spurs — the defending champs start redemptive and physical.

stories.title: Wemby starts 0-for-12 in career-worst night: 'Might be overthinking it'
stories.take: Wembanyama starts 0-for-12 in a career-worst opener against OKC and says he might be overthinking it — night one, owned plainly.

stories.title: Sources: Warriors exploring options to trade center Porzingis
stories.take: Golden State explores trading Porziņģis, out indefinitely with a private health issue — his future as a pro is in doubt.

stories.title: Dončić, in full-page ad, says Lakers title run starts now, asks for fan support
stories.take: Dončić buys a full-page LA Times ad saying the Lakers' title run starts now — a star sets his own expectation in print.

stories.title: What will new-look Wolves look like? By trading for LaMelo Ball, Minnesota swapped 'moodiness for giddiness'
stories.take: Minnesota's LaMelo Ball trade swaps moodiness for giddiness — the new-look Wolves debut against Giannis and Miami is the test.

stories.title: Time to play the game: Haliburton rocks jacket with nod to Triple H in NBA return
stories.take: Haliburton marks his NBA return in a Triple H jacket — the entrance is theater, the return is the story.

stories.title: Ohtani won't require surgery; Dodgers 'fully expect him to pitch next year'
stories.take: Ohtani needs no surgery and the Dodgers fully expect him to pitch in 2027 — the best possible news on the two-way star.

stories.title: 2026 World Series odds, prediction: Full preview for Brewers vs. Rays in Fall Classic
stories.take: Full World Series preview: Brewers vs. Rays, two first-title hopefuls — odds, matchups and the pick in one place.

stories.title: Jacob Misiorowski gets World Series Game 1 start for Brewers as he looks to reclaim his ace stuff
stories.take: Misiorowski gets the Game 1 start for Milwaukee, tasked with reclaiming his ace stuff on the biggest stage.

stories.title: Suzuki out as Angels manager; interim GM Mozeliak won't return in 2027
stories.take: Kurt Suzuki is out after the Angels' first 100-loss season and interim GM Mozeliak won't return — a full reset in Anaheim.

stories.title: Yankees, Cashman reach new contract; Steinbrenner puts blame on offense
stories.take: Cashman gets a new Yankees contract while Steinbrenner blames the offense — continuity at the top, accountability aimed at the lineup.

stories.title: Boone spurns calls for culture change; Yankees clubhouse remains a 'strength'
stories.take: Boone rejects calls for a culture change and calls the clubhouse a strength — the Yankees close ranks at season's end.

stories.title: A's Fisher bets on youth with Smith hire: 'the world is run by 31-year-olds today'
stories.take: The A's hand baseball operations to 31-year-old Taylor Smith — Fisher bets the franchise on youth, in his own words.

stories.title: Once long shots, Brewers, Rays carry sportsbook liability into World Series
stories.take: Long-shot Brewers and Rays carry real sportsbook liability into the World Series — the books are rooting against both Cinderellas.

stories.title: Ilhan Omar says US agents seized 17 items in raid designed to ‘freak’ her out
stories.take: Omar says federal agents seized 17 items in a raid designed to freak her out — the search of a sitting congresswoman escalates.

stories.title: ‘Man, I loved that’: Trump cheers South Carolina rally attender who hit protester
stories.take: Trump cheers a South Carolina rally attendee who hit a protester — 'Man, I loved that' becomes the clip of the night.

stories.title: American imprisoned by Russia released as Witkoff meets and praises Putin
stories.take: Putin orders the release of jailed American Stephen Hubbard as envoy Witkoff meets him for Ukraine talks — Vance defends Witkoff calling Putin a humanitarian.

stories.title: Some US diplomats told to leave Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attacks
stories.take: Some US diplomats are told to leave Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attacks — the regional risk picture worsens overnight.

stories.title: AIPAC halts endorsements and direct contributions to candidates
stories.take: AIPAC halts endorsements and direct contributions to candidates — a major pro-Israel force steps back from the midterm money game.

stories.title: The Justice Department begins notifying counties where it wants to monitor elections
stories.take: DOJ begins notifying counties where it wants election monitors — the federal presence at polling places becomes a campaign issue itself.

stories.title: Poll: Voters want Congress to be a check on Trump, trust Democrats more on issues
stories.take: A new poll says voters want Congress to check Trump and trust Democrats more on the issues, two weeks before the midterms.

stories.title: Trump's political groups spend nearly $277 million in late midterm blitz on behalf of GOP candidates
stories.take: Trump's political groups pour nearly $277 million into a late midterm blitz for GOP candidates — the money arrives as polls tighten.

stories.title: Supreme court blocks Trump’s bid to restrict gender care for trans prisoners
stories.take: The Supreme Court blocks Trump's bid to restrict gender care for trans prisoners — the administration's policy is paused by the court.

stories.title: Chemical tank explosion in Toledo, Ohio, prompts mass evacuation
stories.take: A chemical tank explosion in Toledo prompts a mass evacuation — the day's breaking domestic emergency.

stories.title: Officials confirm flesh-eating New World screwworm parasite found in US wildlife
stories.take: Officials confirm the flesh-eating New World screwworm parasite in US wildlife in Texas — a livestock nightmare returns to US soil.

stories.title: Pope will not need further cancer treatment, doctors say
stories.take: Doctors say Pope Leo needs no further lung cancer treatment — the Vatican's health watch ends the day with good news.

stories.title: Epstein’s attorney and accountant accused of ‘facilitating and concealing’ his crimes in lawsuit
stories.take: New Mexico sues Epstein's attorney and accountant, accusing them of facilitating and concealing his crimes at the ranch.

stories.title: Thousands of California state workers walk off the job in contract dispute with Newsom
stories.take: Thousands of state workers walk off in a contract dispute with Newsom over pay, telework and health costs — the strike day is settled, the contract is not.

stories.title: Your guide to the California Congressional District 34 race: Gomez vs. Gonzales-Torres
stories.take: CD34 voter guide: Gomez vs. Gonzales-Torres — the LA congressional race, explained for the ballot in hand.

stories.title: ‘Borders on the absurd.’ California fights Trump lawsuit to set aside 20,000 ballots
stories.take: California fights the Trump lawsuit to set aside 20,000 ballots, calling the noncitizen list shoddy — the election-probe fight is now in court.

stories.title: New storm moves into Southern California: What to expect
stories.take: A new storm moves into Southern California with dangerous surf, flooding and debris-flow risk — the wet pattern is not done.

stories.title: Neighbor who allegedly fed coyote involved in Atwater Village attack could be charged
stories.take: The neighbor who allegedly fed the coyote in the Atwater Village attack could be charged — feeding wildlife now carries legal risk.

stories.title: Delivery worker found dead in trunk of Tesla. Suspect assumed aliases to evade police, officials say
stories.take: A delivery worker is found dead in a Tesla trunk and officials say the suspect used aliases to evade police — a grim LA case closes in on a suspect.

stories.title: Two teenage girls spent months plotting a mass shooting in Riverside County, officials say
stories.take: Officials say two teenage girls spent months plotting a mass shooting in Riverside County — a plot stopped before it started.

stories.title: Lopez: Disney built the monorail in a year. LAX's people mover, almost 8, hasn't left the station
stories.take: Lopez: Disney built the monorail in a year; LAX's people mover, at almost eight years, still has not left the station.

stories.title: Why It’s So Hard to Buy One of the Country’s Top-Selling Cars Right Now
stories.take: The answer: the 2026 RAV4 is a new hybrid-only generation needing extensive factory retooling — Toyota delayed the changeover to keep building the 2025 model, so sales are down 30% on supply, not demand • Meta ordered to pay $25B by a New Mexico judge, then reported record Q3 revenue over $64B and a new stock class to fund up to $145B in AI capex • Critical PHP bug, found with AI help, has admins scrambling to patch ~70% of the web

stories.title: Earnings Special: Meta Boosts Bet on AI With Spending Outlook, New Stock Class
stories.take: Meta guides Q4 revenue to $73–76B and narrows 2026 capex to $135–145B, with total expenses raised to $175–179B including a $9.9B legal charge • Q3 revenue $64.2B, up 26% — its highest quarter ever; non-GAAP EPS $7.40 excluding the charge • New non-voting Class C stock (Jan 2027, effectively 2-for-1) gives Meta equity currency for AI talent and M&A without diluting Zuckerberg's control • Reality Labs losses projected at $18–19B for 2026; ad strength is pricing-driven, with AI improving targeting

stories.title: Small town economics clash with Big Tech agendas
stories.take: Prineville, Oregon: Meta and Apple data centers ($8B combined) cut unemployment from near 20% to 6% — but paid $178K and $169K in property tax versus ~$31M without their breaks; Meta's first exemption expires next year and its bill jumps to ~$4M • Abbott spins off its nutrition business (Similac, Ensure), possibly offloading preterm-formula litigation • SpaceX–Tesla merger talk framed as full vertical integration, with a governance catch for Tesla shareholders • Global series wrap: demographics is the slow tidal wave the world economy has not prepared for

stories.title: At The Money: Can Dividend Investing Give You Yield AND Growth?
stories.take: The answer: Yes — dividend growth investing, not high-yield chasing, delivers both rising income and appreciation • Buy when a stock's yield is above its own long-term average and sell when price compresses it too far (Walmart sold at 1.5% vs. a 3.5% norm; Broadcom at 1% after a 16× gain) • Portfolio: 30–35 names, reinvest payouts, ~0.6 beta — income has beaten inflation every calendar year • Warning signs of a cut: borrowing to pay the dividend and payout ratios over 90%

stories.title: Meet Sunil Malhotra, the new voice of Apu on ‘The Simpsons’
stories.take: Sunil Malhotra is the new voice of Apu after Hank Azaria stepped away and the character was silent for 9 years • He negotiated creative input before accepting: jokes must center Apu's humanity — overworked dad of eight, rekindled marriage — not caricature, or he would walk • Janina Gavankar takes over as Manjula • The return episode's monologue about the empty house and abandoned Kwik-E-Mart reads, for Malhotra, as a metaphor for South Asian erasure: being there but not being seen

stories.title: Eaton fire whistleblower sues LACO over retaliation, CA voter fraud, Porto's Bakery coming to IE— Afternoon Edition
stories.take: OEM associate director Nicholas Vicaro sues LA County, alleging retaliation after he raised Eaton Fire response concerns through whistleblower channels • He alleges OEM understaffed the response and alerts, and committed fraud to obtain FEMA reimbursement • Prior reporting: a retired employee with a history of sleeping on the job was put in charge of overnight evacuation-alert staffing on the fire's first night — the county denies he slept or caused West Altadena delays • The county declined to comment and will answer in court

stories.title: Parents of e-bike death charged, Long Beach protest after ICE altercation,  Angels manager fired— Evening Edition
stories.take: Parents of 13-year-old Benson Wen, killed riding an e-motorcycle over 40 mph, are charged with child endangerment — at least 10 other OC parents face similar charges; arraignment Nov 12 • Dozens protest in Long Beach after ICE agents allegedly broke a US citizen former city worker's arm; the mayor filed a complaint demanding an independent investigation • OC county workers pause their strike for mediation, with a special supervisors session Friday • Angels fire Kurt Suzuki after the franchise's first 100-loss season (62–100)
